## Historical audit

**Source:** S0186, original file `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/service_incident_01/retired/results/r1/generic_rsi/C1/test/commons_163096530/trajectory.jsonl`. All citations below refer to this file. The supplied observations contain complete lines, not split observations.

| Evidence | Observation and interpretation |
|---|---|
| Line 1, `model_request`, characters [0,10097) | The student was asked to reconstruct a 512 × 341 indoor RGB photograph in SceneAct and Blender, matching framing, occlusion, colors and materials with separate meshes. The image was referenced by path, but its pixels are not included in this audit; the actual scene contents cannot be independently described. The requested reconstruction is a goal, not an observed result. |
| Line 2, `codex_session`, characters [0,2624) | One fresh, read-only student CLI session was launched with the staged image. It failed with exit code 1 after about 19.5 seconds; zero tool calls and tool events were recorded. The actual model and underlying inference-round count are unknown. |
| Lines 3–4, `model_error` and `scene_error`, characters [0,544) and [0,1606) respectively | The wrapper reported the nonzero exit and pointed to a stderr log; the scene traceback propagated the error from the student call. The log contents are not supplied, so the underlying cause is unknown. |

**Outcome:** Technical interruption before any visible student response, program, scene build, render, revision or validation. No actual changes are evidenced. This is not evidence of an algorithmic reconstruction failure, partial geometric correctness, an empty patch, or formal success; reconstruction quality remains unknown.

**Scene checks:** Although the request called for multiple objects and materials, the record provides no observable reconstructed objects, textures, connections, pose, camera, lighting or render to check. Neither their correctness nor their absence in the reference photograph can be established. No autonomous exploration is visible beyond the single failed session; the CLI turn count does not establish what occurred inside the model.

**Teacher input:** No teacher event, diagnosis, proposed update, execution or student adoption is visible. The reconstruction and API instructions in line 1 are task/system input, not evidence of teacher feedback.

**Lessons and uncertainty:** Transferably, a failed model session and missing render cannot validate scene quality; the supplied stderr pointer would be necessary to investigate the immediate failure, but its contents are unavailable here. The task-specific image contents and any possible camera or geometry issues remain unresolved hypotheses, not observed defects.
